clue.text: Put out fire

definitions.meaning: to put out is to emit or release, as a factory releases waste
to fire someone is to dismiss them from a job

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: emitting liquid or smoke, and sacking an employee or firing a gun.

clue.text: The strain of mourning

parts.note: strain suggests stress or grief, but here it is a tune, a sorrowful melody played at a funeral

explanation.definitionFit: A funeral lament is a melody, and strain is an old word for a tune.

clue.text: Reg is involved with this trial shot

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so the letters of the two words are mixed together

explanation.surface: Someone called Reg is taking part in a practice shot.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'is' is only a link: the letters of REG and THIS together are rearranged under 'involved with'.
explanation.definitionFit: In shooting, a practice round fired to check the aim before scoring begins is called by this name.

clue.text: Layer on article turned to shade of red

parts.note: a layer is something that lays eggs, a hen

indicators.note: turned tells us the short word for the article is read backwards

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Applying a coat over some item changed its colour to reddish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Layer' reads as a coating, but it is something that lays eggs. In a down clue 'on' puts HEN above NA.
explanation.definitionFit: The dye from this plant gives hair a reddish-brown colour, so its name is also the colour.

clue.text: Not a change for the better

definitions.text: Not a change for the better

parts.words: Not a change for the better
parts.note: a change for the worse, typically a patient falling ill again after recovering

explanation.definitionFit: A patient sliding back into illness after improving has suffered a worsening, not an improvement.

clue.text: Left for dead, for example

parts.note: reads as abandoned to die, but means the word left used in place of dead as a gentler term

explanation.definitionFit: Saying someone has left us instead of saying they died is a mild substitute expression.

clue.text: Entrance for spectators

definitions.meaning: a way in through a fence or wall
the number of people attending a sports match, as in a big crowd figure

explanation.definitionFit: A way in through a fence, and also the attendance count at a football match.

clue.text: It's an Israeli region I allege, wrongly

indicators.note: wrongly says the letters are set out in the wrong order and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A speaker claims, perhaps falsely, that some place belongs to Israel.
explanation.definitionFit: This northern area around the Sea of the same name lies in Israel.

clue.text: Straight hit in international cricket — going for a run

parts.note: a Test is an international cricket match
a drive is a straight attacking stroke in cricket

explanation.surface: A batsman's straight shot in a Test match as he sets off to score.
explanation.walkthrough: The cricket picture is a decoy: the 'run' is a trial spin in a car before buying it.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking a car out on the road to try it before purchase is a trial outing.

clue.text: First love, with a girl in torment

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, a nought, the letter O

indicators.note: torment suggests twisting and agony, so the letters are wrenched into a new order

explanation.surface: A man's first sweetheart, a girl who left him in anguish.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram covers A GIRL plus IN, giving RIGINAL.
explanation.definitionFit: The earliest version, the first of its kind, is the prototype rather than a copy.

clue.text: European may be French

definitions.meaning: French ... is a glossy finish for wood

explanation.definitionFit: A Pole is a native of a European country, and a gloss for furniture is called French polish.

clue.text: Bunk with a woman!

parts.note: a berth is a bunk on a ship or train

explanation.surface: An exclamation suggesting someone shares a bed with a lady.
explanation.definitionFit: A traditional female first name.

clue.text: Leave out one note in introductory piece

indicators.note: in tells us the note goes inside the piece

parts.note: a prelude is an introductory piece of music
C is one of the musical notes

explanation.surface: Instructions to omit one note from the opening section of a musical work.
explanation.definitionFit: To rule out or prevent something is to exclude it from happening.

clue.text: Free-for-all sort of arrangement

indicators.note: free means let loose, so the letters of the words that follow are allowed to rearrange

explanation.surface: A free-for-all is a chaotic brawl, here dressed up as a kind of order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Free-for-all' reads as one word for a brawl; split it and 'Free' rearranges FORALL.
explanation.definitionFit: A bouquet of flowers is a typical example of an arrangement described with this adjective.

clue.text: Inferior position he's in, not I

definitions.text: Inferior position he's in, not I

parts.words: Inferior position he's in, not I
parts.note: small letters are the lower position of type; the word he is printed small, but the pronoun I is always a capital

explanation.definitionFit: Small letters sat in the lower type tray, and the pronoun I is always written as a capital.

clue.text: Where to make a final stand in trench warfare?

definitions.text: Where to make a final stand in trench warfare?

parts.words: Where to make a final stand in trench warfare?
parts.note: the final trench of a defensive line is where soldiers make their very last resistance

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means a desperate final effort, from the final trench defended in battle.

clue.text: Widespread, half in verse

indicators.note: in places the word for half within the word for verse

parts.note: an epic is a long poem in verse
demi is a prefix meaning half

explanation.surface: Something extends broadly through half of a poem.
explanation.definitionFit: A disease outbreak affecting many people at once is widespread by nature.

clue.text: Inducts into office when answer is correct

indicators.note: correct, as a verb, means put right, so the letters are set into the proper order

explanation.surface: Someone is admitted to a post once they give the right reply.
explanation.definitionFit: An official is formally installed by taking an oath of office.

clue.text: Refuse to vote, putting Jack on the spot

indicators.note: on, in a down clue, puts the sailor above the mark

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, and AB is an able-bodied seaman
a stain is a spot or mark

explanation.surface: Declining to vote, as if Jack were put on the spot by the question.
explanation.definitionFit: Deliberately not casting a vote is to hold back from voting.

clue.text: It joins another for a breather

definitions.text: It joins another for a breather

parts.words: It joins another for a breather
parts.note: a breather sounds like a rest, but here it is breathing; one nasal opening works with its twin

explanation.definitionFit: The nose has two openings that together let us breathe.

clue.text: Attacked and bombed at random

indicators.note: at random means in no set order, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A place was assaulted and bombed indiscriminately.
explanation.definitionFit: Being surrounded and set upon by a crowd is being attacked.

clue.text: Secures damages

definitions.meaning: fastens, as a belt is fastened with a clasp
bends and crumples, as metal gives way under pressure

explanation.definitionFit: It means fastens with a clasp, and also bends or distorts something out of shape.

clue.text: Struggles to maintain faith in the past

definitions.text: to maintain faith in the past
definitions.meaning: the medieval Christian military expeditions to the Holy Land

explanation.definitionFit: These are both determined campaigns for a cause and the historic religious wars of the Middle Ages.

clue.text: Agree it's of small account and acquiesce

parts.note: a small or abbreviated form of account is AC
to cede is to yield or give way

explanation.surface: Someone agrees that the matter is unimportant and gives in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Of small account' looks like meaning trivial; 'small' really signals an abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: To consent to a request is to agree to it.

clue.text: Advantage point in a number of games

indicators.note: in places the compass point within the other pieces

parts.note: a set is a group of games in tennis
S, south, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Winning a point within a sequence of tennis games gives an edge.
explanation.definitionFit: A useful quality or resource is something that gives an advantage.

clue.text: Takes a girl out fruit

definitions.meaning: goes on a romantic outing with someone
the sweet fruit of a palm tree

explanation.definitionFit: It means goes out with someone romantically, and the sticky fruit of the palm.

clue.text: He's learned to park a vehicle in the street

indicators.note: in, with park, puts the vehicle inside the street abbreviation

parts.note: a van is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A driver has learned how to park a van on the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He's learned' reads as a verb, but it describes a person who is learned.
explanation.definitionFit: A very knowledgeable scholar is a learned person.

clue.text: Intent on rendering two notes on an instrument

parts.note: re is a note of the sol-fa scale
so is another note of the sol-fa scale
a lute is a stringed instrument

explanation.surface: A musician is set on playing a pair of notes on a stringed instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: Being determined and fixed in purpose is being intent on something.

clue.text: I object to an average standard

parts.note: I in its object form is me

explanation.surface: Someone protests against a merely ordinary level.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I object' reads as a protest, but it asks for the object form of I.
explanation.definitionFit: In statistics the arithmetic average of a set of values is its central figure.

clue.text: Hoist sail to break loose from personal unpleasantness

indicators.note: break loose suggests the letters escape their order and rearrange

explanation.surface: Sailors raise the sails to escape from a nasty individual.
explanation.definitionFit: Bad breath is a personal problem that is unpleasant for others.
